northumbriaConstruct.summary: I founded Northumbria Construct as an industry–academia initiative to help connect students and emerging professionals with universities, professional institutions and the construction industry.
northumbriaConstruct.purpose: Its activities are designed to create practical routes into professional knowledge and networks through debates, seminars, site visits, webinars and collaborative projects.

norcon.summary: NorCon Projects is an emerging lightweight Project Operating System being developed to address fragmented project information, controls and collaboration through a clearer working structure.
norcon.purpose: The product direction is intended for small project teams and emerging project professionals. It focuses on accessible governance, document and reporting workflows, with an emphasis on clarity rather than unnecessary complexity.
